name: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Crazy Party
description:
Grizzy just wanted a little peace and quiet... but the Lemmings had other plans! Take control of these unstoppable little troublemakers and turn your living room into a total madhouse: unpredictable mini-games, boards full of surprises, and dirty tricks between friends, every round can flip in seconds. One goal: grab as much Yummy as you can before everyone else, and drive Grizzy up the wall.

50 Wild Mini-Games
Precision, speed, reflexes, memory, observation, or pure survival instinct: every challenge is varied, absurd, and full of twists. A race can come down to the very last second, and a friend can always steal your win at the worst possible moment.

6 Game Modes for Every Mood
A quick round, a full game night, a duel between die-hards, or pure button-mashing mayhem, there's always a reason for one more game.

5 Boards Inspired by the Series
From the Ranger's Cabin to the Yummy factory and the mountain trail, plus 2 secret boards to unlock, each one has its own setting, pace, and surprises.

On the Couch, Up to 4 Players
A 100% local experience, in the same room, built for game nights with friends and family alike. Instantly fun, easy to pick up, and playable with up to 4 players on a single screen, one controller each.

Unlock, Collect, Replay
With the rewards machine, unlock 40 Lemmings and complete your collection of 150 stickers as you play.

Key Features
- Family party game for 1-4 players, local
- 50 mini-games, 6 game modes, 5 boards
- 40 Lemmings to unlock, 150 stickers to collect
- 100% faithful to the Grizzy and the Lemmings animated series
- Chaos, dirty tricks, and big laughs, for everyone

Everything's ready: pick your Lemming, keep an eye on your friends, and never leave a jar of Yummy unattended.
